translit:
|| Ath Sharanu ||

Jivanji Maharaj magu sharanu tamaru | Sharanu tamaru rama sharanu tamaru ||
Krishnadasne bhakti api | Sarve bhaktoni kashti kapi ||1||
Bhoja Gujarno uddhar kidho | Keshavdasne sharane lidho ||
Guru sandhate yatra vishe | Marwadne ugaryo ||2||
Krishna Keshavne nimit karine | Kantho Surat taryo ||
Padmanabh Gnaniji dada | Shukdevji Gopal ||3||
Jivanji e krupa karine | Ugarya sahu bal ||
Ramkabirni dradh naukama | Jivanji besade ||4||
Krupa karine Kabir krupalo | Bhavsagar utare ||
Jivanjina bal gopalo | Ramkabir ucharo ||5||
Bhavsagarthi taravano e | Sundar chhe bahu aro ||
Ananya bhakti nam nishtha ne | Satsangatine dharo ||6||
Avivas ne dushit bhojan | Salil sangne taro ||
Nihshank hoi ne bhajan karo to | Nam phale tatkal ||7||
Muj papine sharane lidho | Eva din dayal ||
Sadguru Jivan chho nijnam | Jivan Krishna Jivan Ram ||8||
Sadguru Jivan chho nijnam | Jivan Kabir Jivan Ram ||
Harmaba par krupa karine | Kanam Pal ugari ||9||

|| Iti Sharanu sampurna ||

Prasad upar tulsi patra mukti vakhate bolvani
translation:
|| Here begins the Sharanu (the prayer of taking refuge) ||

Opening line. Jivanji Maharaj, I beg for your refuge — your refuge, O Rama, your refuge.

1. You gave Krishnadas the gift of bhakti (devotion); you cut away the sufferings of all the devotees.

2. You brought about the deliverance of Bhoja Gujar, and took Keshavdas into your refuge. On pilgrimage in the company of the Guru, you saved Marwad.

3. Making Krishna and Keshav your instruments, you delivered the coastal country and Surat. Padmanabh, the wise elder Gnaniji, Shukdevji, Gopal —

4. Jivanji showed his grace and rescued all these children of his. Jivanji seats them in the steady boat of Ramkabir.

5. Showing his grace, the compassionate Kabir carries them across the ocean of worldly existence. O children and cowherd-boys of Jivanji, utter the name "Ramkabir".

6. This is a beautiful and ample landing-place for crossing over the ocean of existence: hold fast to undivided bhakti (devotion), steadfastness in the Name, and satsang (holy company).

7. Cast away faithlessness, defiled food, and loose company (salil sang). Worship without any doubt, and the Name bears fruit at once.

8. He took even me, a sinner, into his refuge — such is he, merciful to the lowly. Sadguru (true master) Jivan, you are the very Name itself: Jivan is Krishna, Jivan is Ram.

9. Sadguru Jivan, you are the very Name itself: Jivan is Kabir, Jivan is Ram. Showing his grace upon Harmaba, he saved the Kanam and Pal regions.

|| Here the Sharanu is complete ||

[Heading on page 175:] To be recited while placing a tulsi leaf upon the prasad (sanctified food offering).
